title: Return two values
summary: Lua: Return two values. Return 4 and 6. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: Lua functions can return several values. A matching assignment reads them.

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.

blocks.title: Return two values
blocks.code:
local function pair()
 return 3, 5
end
local a, b = pair()
print(a + b)

blocks.text: The function returns 3 and 5. Two variables receive them and their sum is 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: One receiving variable keeps only the first returned value.
